sn46.13:1.1: Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yadidam aruṇuggam ||
sn46.13:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sattannam bojjhaṅgānam uppādāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idaṃ yonisomanasikāro || ||
sn46.13:1.3: Yonisomanasikārasampannessetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ satta bojjhaṅge bhāvessati satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarissati || || 3.
sn46.13:2.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti sattabojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti || ||
sn46.13:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti || pe-
sn46.13:2.3: la || upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekavirāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn46.13:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti sattabojjhaṅge bahulīkarotī ti || || 1. Evam me
